_comment: Base rates the public analyst reads instead of recomputing. Emitted by research 0024;
Its caller is the Phase 2 fact-sheet builder (radar roast), which needs a population to
quote a per-mint recipient count against and must not decode 483,629 launches to get one.
Until that exists this file is a published measurement and nothing reads it -- said plainly
because AGENTS.md section 5 asks for a layer's caller to be named, and this repository has
produced three things nothing depends on.
EVERY FIGURE HERE HAS A DATE ON IT AND IS EXPECTED TO MOVE. 0008 measured the same
quantities on 2026-08-25 and its headline was wrong by 2.7x nine days later. A consumer
that hard-codes any of these numbers is repeating that mistake. Read measured_on, and
refuse rather than guess when this file is absent -- absent is not zero (rule 9), and a
missing base rate means the claim cannot be made, not that the rate is zero.

launch_block._comment: Distinct token accounts receiving the token inside its own launch block. NOT owners, NOT buyers -- see 0012. Never imply a cabal identity from these.

share_with_exactly_six._comment: 0008 reported 0.05 / 0.16 / 0.68. Quoting 'six, versus 5% otherwise' is wrong twice: the instant figure is 2.7x too high, and 'otherwise' hides the organic cohort.

histogram._comment: recipients -> [never_graduated, organic, instant]. The 14+ tail is folded in 0024's table but kept split here.

creator_history._comment: Re-measurement of 0007 at a pinned pivot. Graduation predicts VOLATILITY, NOT PROFIT (0011): organic graduations end at a median -3228 bps against -853 for never-graduated. Nothing may present a creator's graduation history as a good sign.

ratios._comment: 0007 reported 2.12x band-vs-band and 1.69x against base. Quote whichever is meant and say which -- the two differ by more than a factor of two.

round_trip_bps._comment: Three numbers, reconciled in docs/STATE.md. Never publish one without knowing which. by_notional is 0019's measured per-leg median, doubled.
